notes: Split-screen hooks are now read edge to edge - whether the split fades in over the first few seconds or the bottom goes calm (a pool settling) mid-hook, the whole split is kept, so the talking part after the hook lands right and you no longer get a missing or doubled talking part before the body. Also: the creator talking right after a reaction hook is recognized even when the person in the hook is someone else.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.94.
